plasticity.explanation: gap~0: attention has the largest choice main-effect (beta) and its interaction is never overtaken -> weak-interaction collapse regime.

routing_unconstrained.explanation: gap=0 on quality alone: the semantic path dominates (solves EASY and HARD) -> quality-dominance collapse.

routing_budget_kappa_0.5.explanation: gap>0: the 50% budget forbids the dominant semantic path everywhere; the oracle spends it on HARD. This is why routing v2 was identifiable — cost, not quality.

plasticity_cost_budget_note: REVIVAL: the original λ=0 gap is ~0, but for λ∈[0.5,1.0] the cost-weighted oracle allocates the CHEAP 'head' group to lexical (which it can solve) and reserves the expensive 'attn' only for relational (structurally necessary) — beating any fixed group. gap≈0.19 at λ=1, identical across all 5 seeds.
